subject: gov.standards
name: Mobile quality-of-service thresholds
what_would_settle_it: The text of ARCEP decision n°000012/ARCEP/CNRCEP/21 of 10 December 2021, or any official statement of the indicators and thresholds mobile operators are measured against.
disposition: partly found — ARCEP's own 2021 annual report gives the decision's full title and function (indicators of quality of service and coverage, publication of the coverage map, and the control protocol) but not its thresholds. ARCEP states the four mises en demeure are published on its site; the annual report and the mises en demeure are raised as acquisition lines. The thresholds themselves remain unpublished.

subject: infra.capacity
name: National data centre capacity
what_would_settle_it: A rack, floor-area, power or storage figure for the Tier III data centre accepted at Niamey in November 2025, from the digital economy ministry, ANSI or the AfDB project documents.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the AfDB's own release and the two Nigerien accounts give the fibre kilometres, the five axes and the 88 km loop, and no capacity figure for the data centre; the AfDB release is staged to new/ for the fibre detail.

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to network sites and data centres
what_would_settle_it: An operator, NIGELEC or regulator statement quantifying outage exposure or backup provision for telecommunications sites and the national data centre.
disposition: absence stands, dated — NIGELEC load-shedding of two to three hours is well documented for 2025, and a 30 MW solar plant entered service in 2024, but nothing published quantifies exposure or backup for network sites.

subject: finance.budget
name: Public budget allocation to digital government
what_would_settle_it: A Nigerien budget or expenditure statement carrying an identifiable appropriation for communications, digital economy, ANSI or ARCEP.
disposition: found — the finance ministry publishes Ordonnance n°2025-44 of 31 December 2025 carrying the 2026 finance law at finances.gouv.ne; raised as an acquisition line.
